messages:
sara: Heads up — seeing a regression on quantized runs after the kernel-selector refactor. 4-bit mixed path is ~18% slower on long-context runs (seq=1024) with KV cache warm.

Tom: can you paste the run summary? config + commit? :eyes:

sara: run metadata: commit=7f3a2b2 (kernel-selector refactor), model=mosaic-13b-qlora, quant=4bit-mixed, hw=A100-80GB, batcher=adaptive_v2, calib=per-layer-abs

sara: perf numbers (median over 10 samples):
```
seq=128: 520 toks/s (baseline 540)
seq=512: 190 toks/s (baseline 230)
seq=1024: 95 toks/s (baseline 116)
```

jin: interesting — regression grows with seq len. suggests KV / attention kernel mismatch. did profiler show more memcpy or kernel launches?

sara: yes. nvprof flame shows extra kernel 'dequant_apply' on the critical path and a fallback to slow matmul kernel for attn_qk at longer seqs. link: https://perf.internal/runs/1845550000/flame

kevin: could be calibration producing wider dynamic range and forcing slower fp32 paths. which calib mode used?

sara: per-layer abs scale (our new default). I re-ran with calibration=global-minmax and saw seq=1024 improve to 108 toks/s (closer to baseline). So calib mode affects kernel selection.

Tom: replication plan: reproduce with unit runner `bench/runner --model=mosaic-13b --quant=4bit --calib=per-layer-abs --seq=1024 --batch=1 --repeats=10`. Sara can you attach the exact runner command you used?

sara: `bench/runner --commit=7f3a2b2 --model=mosaic-13b --quant=4bit --calib=per-layer-abs --seq=128,512,1024 --batcher=adaptive_v2 --warmup=100 --repeats=10 --dump=nvprof` :thumbsup: 

jin: also try forcing `kernel_selector=legacy` to confirm selector is root cause. if legacy matches baseline -> selector bug.

sara: did that. `kernel_selector=legacy` restores seq=1024 to 118 toks/s. So selector picks new kernel for dequant path.

kevin: action items:
- sara: collect nvprof traces + small repro that reproduces quickly (seq=1024, batch=1)
- tom: bisect kernel-selector commits for heuristics that change threshold
- jin: add test to CI that runs short long-ctx quantized run to catch perf regressions
- eng-ml: evaluate effect of calib mode on quantized kernel decisions and add mapping table

sara: attaching condensed nvprof + callstack in the run artifact. I'll ping eng-ml once I have the minimal repro. :rocket:

perf-bot: automated alert: perf delta 18% for 4bit-mixed @ seq=1024 on A100. Threshold exceeded.

Tom: thanks — let's keep this thread as the coordination point. if anyone hits it earlier ping me.

kevin: +1 — schedule a 30m sync if we need to align on selector heuristics.

sara: FYI I also saw KV cache cold vs warm matters: cold KV has smaller regressions; warm KV triggers dequant kernel more often. probably because cached KV shapes change dispatch.

jin: note for benchmark methodology: include both cold/warm KV profiles and explicit warmup tokens; don't rely solely on backend's warmup. Also capture tokenization variability across bytepair boundaries. propose adding `--kv-warm=full|none|partial` to runner.

sara: agreed. I'll update the perf playbook with: warmup=200, power-limit=250W, seed=42, tokenization-check=true, calib-modes=[per-layer-abs,global-minmax,None], kernel-selector flags recorded.

Tom: perfect. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
